signatures.description: A TypeScript Vitest integration suite had one file with a shared live-server probe and describe.skipIf guard while health.test.ts fetched the pinned server URL unconditionally. On a clean-style environment with TEST_BASE_URL pointed at a dead port, the suite failed with ECONNREFUSED in health.test.ts even though api.test.ts skipped. The fix was to extract the probe into a shared helper and apply the same guard to health.test.ts, with network-free unit tests for the probe. Verification: dead-port run 313 passed and 12 skipped; live run 325 passed; build and lint passed.
